The facility does not maintain a complete medical record for all dogs. For most puppies, the facility writes down the dates
treatments are given but does not provide the names of the treatments. The facility states that the animals are up to date
on vaccines and deworming treatments. Failure to maintain adequate medical records may interfere with the ability of
APHIS officials to determine if the animals are receiving adequate veterinary care. Complete medical records must be
maintained and include the names of all vaccines and treatments administered and the dates of administration. Correct by
documenting all treatments given and ensure that medical records are complete and contain the required information.
Correct by 21-JULY-2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the Licensee.

narrative:
3.13(b)(3) 
   
Veterinary care for dogs. 
The facility does not maintain a complete medical record for all dogs. For most puppies, the facility writes down the dates 
treatments are given but does not provide the names of the treatments. The facility states that the animals are up to date 
on vaccines and deworming treatments. Failure to maintain adequate medical records may interfere with the ability of 
APHIS officials to determine if the animals are receiving adequate veterinary care. Complete medical records must be 
maintained and include the names of all vaccines and treatments administered and the dates of administration. Correct by 
documenting all treatments given and ensure that medical records are complete and contain the required information. 
Correct by 21-JULY-2026. 
 
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the Licensee.
